messages.subject: "Successful"...yet receiving an error message?
parts:
Hi All!

I posted a while back over the summer when I was struggling to format some of the language in the script in the DEC model. I am still working on the same project, and have been running into the same error message at the completion of the code "res = bears_optim_run(BioGeoBEARS_run_object)". The data set I had been attempting to use was quite large, with 10 areas, and a max of 10 areas (I know this is large, but this is as far as we were able to cut it down), with 119 species (tips). I attempted running a smaller portion of the data set, containing only 17 species, and received the error message I have attached as an image below. Does anyone know what this error message means? It says successful, and seems to be running and functioning properly the entire time, up until the very end. I have also attached the geography and phylogeny files as well, if anyone wants to give it a shot. 

Any help or suggestions are greatly appreciated! Thank you!

H. Bennett Stephens
Kenyon College
Class of 2015
Biology
